leadership_coverage.prebreakout_method: unbroken 20/50D pivot proximity + leader RS + acceleration + supply absorption + nearby demand + dry volume
leadership_coverage.diffusion_method: eventized sector breadth diffusion + pre-ignition stock/sector relative breakout; Stock Capture excluded
leadership_coverage.rotation_method: PRIMARY: eventized Sector Diffusion -> pre-ignition Early Leader -> first pullback/tight breakout; legacy scores are tie-break/context only
